facts.value: If item pickup succeeds, its callee enters LightGet or HeavyGet and no AttackS3 entry runs. Otherwise: angle > x9C and AttackS3S record x8 != 0 selects AttackS3Hi; else angle > xA0 and AttackS3LwS record x8 != 0 selects AttackS3HiS; else angle < xA8 and AttackLw3 record x8 != 0 selects AttackS3Lw; else angle < xA4 and AttackHi3 record x8 != 0 selects AttackS3LwS; else selects AttackS3S. All comparisons are strict. Entry clears allow_interrupt, changes motion with no flags, frame zero, rate one and zero blend, then calls ftAnim_8006EBA4. x8 is a size_t value, not a pointer.
facts.rationale: Correct pointer-versus-size type, pickup transition, exact branch semantics or object flags using canonical and object evidence.
